message.content: /deep-research Of the 56 people who signed the Declaration of Independence, excluding any future presidents and anyone born outside of the US, which of them actually died before American independence was officially won?

input.content:
# Research Plan

## Goal
Identify which of the 56 signers of the Declaration of Independence died before American independence was officially won (Treaty of Paris, September 3, 1783), excluding future presidents and anyone born outside the US.

## Components
1. Complete list of 56 signers of the Declaration of Independence
2. Death dates for each signer
3. Birth places for each signer (to exclude those born outside US)
4. Future presidents among signers (to exclude them)
5. Determine which signers died before September 3, 1783

## Constraints
- Only include signers born in what is now the US (the 13 colonies/states)
- Exclude John Adams and Thomas Jefferson (both future presidents)
- American independence officially won = Treaty of Paris signed September 3, 1783
- Provide citations for every fact

## Queries

### High depth
1. "Complete list of 56 signers of the Declaration of Independence with birth places and death dates"
2. "Which signers of the Declaration of Independence were born outside the United States"

### Medium depth
3. "John Adams Thomas Jefferson signers Declaration of Independence future presidents"
4. "Treaty of Paris 1783 date American independence officially won"

### Low depth
5. "Death dates of Declaration of Independence signers who died before 1783"

Based on the research, here's the answer:

## Signers who died before American independence was officially won (Sep 3, 1783), excluding future presidents and those born outside the US

**7 signers** meet all criteria:

| Signer | State Represented | Birthplace (Colony) | Death Date |
|--------|-------------------|---------------------|------------|
| **John Morton** | Pennsylvania | Pennsylvania | c. 1777 |
| **Philip Livingston** | New York | New York | June 12, 1778 |
| **John Hart** | New Jersey | New Jersey | May 11, 1779 |
| **Joseph Hewes** | North Carolina | New Jersey (Kingston) | October 10, 1779 |
| **George Ross** | Pennsylvania | Delaware (New Castle) | July 14, 1779 |
| **Thomas Lynch Jr.** | South Carolina | South Carolina | c. 1779 |
| **Richard Stockton** | New Jersey | New Jersey | February 28, 1781 |

---

### Exclusions applied

1. **Future presidents (2):** John Adams, Thomas Jefferson — both died in 1826
2. **Born outside the US (8):** Button Gwinnett (England), Robert Morris (England), Francis Lewis (Wales), James Smith (Northern Ireland), George Taylor (Ireland), Matthew Thornton (Ireland), James Wilson (Scotland), John Witherspoon (Scotland)
   - Of these, **Button Gwinnett** (d. May 1777) and **George Taylor** (d. Feb 1781) died before Sep 3, 1783, but are excluded due to foreign birth

---

### Key dates
- **Treaty of Paris signed:** September 3, 1783 — the official end of the war and recognition of US independence [1][2]
- **Declaration signed:** August 2, 1776 (most signatures)

---

## Sources

[1] https://www.archives.gov/founding-docs/signers-factsheet  
[2] https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/treaty-of-paris  
[3] https://declaration.fas.harvard.edu/faq/how-many-signers-were-born-american-colonies  
[4] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Signing_of_the_United_States_Declaration_of_Independence
